message.content: LiHua expressed interest in watching "The Last of Us" after receiving an enthusiastic recommendation from Emily Burnett. Emily had praised the game for its gripping storyline, emotionally rich characters, and intense gameplay, which she believes will be appealing to LiHua, who enjoyed games with strong narratives like "Witcher 3". LiHua confirmed her interest in giving the game a try, planning to watch it this weekend after hearing that it is highly recommended. LiHua also noted that she was curious about how the game adaptation differs from the original video game. Given this information, LiHua intends to watch "The Last of Us" to experience its emotional depth and engaging narrative firsthand.
